text:
alex: Heads-up — found an out-of-date auth example in quickstart Node README that breaks onboarding. Repro steps below.

alex: Bad curl snippet in examples/quickstart-node/README.md (old copy/paste):
```bash
curl -X POST \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "Authorization: API_KEY $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  --data '{"input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

alex: Hitting the new runtime returns 401 because we've standardized on Bearer tokens and the SDK constructors accept `token` now instead of `apiKey`.

maya: Ugh, that explains several onboarding tickets. Can you paste the exact error body you saw?

alex: Sure — response was: `{"error":"invalid auth","code":401}`. Also the JS sample uses `new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` which is stale.

nora: Sounds like snippet drift after the token rename. Please open a PR with corrected examples and a short note about env var differences.

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/358 — updates README to use `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_TOKEN`, updates JS + Python client snippets, and updates .env.example.

alex: Updated JS example in PR:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', input: 'hello' });
```

alex: Updated curl example in PR:
```bash
curl -X POST \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_TOKEN" \n  --data '{"input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

sam: Small ask — add a note that our local dev helper uses `REDWOOD_DEV_TOKEN` so folks don't get confused between DEV vs PROD env names.

alex: Yep added a short callout to .env.example and the README. Also added a tiny script snippet showing `export REDWOOD_DEV_TOKEN=...` so people can try locally.

devex-bot: PR merged into main at 1799991200 ✅ https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/9f8d7a2

maya: I'll run a repo-wide grep for `Authorization: API_KEY` and `apiKey:` to catch remaining drift and open follow-ups.

alex: Thanks — this should reduce the onboarding noise.

nora: Closing thread once grep follow-ups are created. :thumbsup:
